body:
The original SPN-098 validation reported failures in the durable-running and readiness-first authenticated-restore tests. This full **L** investigation preserves both failures and verifies the complete observable recovery contract. It proposes **bounded non-recurrence with historical cause unknown**, rather than claiming a historical diagnosis or repair.

Reviewed source: `f59d23ceae976ee0abdd25eb13f370e18d7d6495`; actual base: `87c34e30ed810e6789d876e55b23dcbb349fa506`; source tree: `5d8c93740959386dce7d85858f1ce85cdcc9c6fd`. Twelve documentation/evidence/backlog files; +863/−88 text lines (892 changed excluding the generated index), plus an 83,272-byte compressed original log. No runtime, test, workflow, dependency or UI implementation change.

### 🧭 Explicit investigation decision and full contract

The [canonical decision](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/blob/f59d23ceae976ee0abdd25eb13f370e18d7d6495/docs/implementation/SPN-157.md#-bounded-investigation-method-and-full-contract-audit) openly changes the investigation's stopping method: accept either a demonstrated defect with repair, or bounded non-recurrence **only when every original behavioral/negative requirement is verified and no supported current defect remains**. It does not weaken an assertion, increase a deadline, add retries, reduce L scope or claim “fixed by SPN-160.” Missing historical action/stage/child/IPC progress cannot be reconstructed from later passes.

All four personas retain their contracts: Operator gets finite, inspectable recovery evidence; Owner keeps exact original/candidate data and persistence; Collaborator keeps authenticated, truthful, fail-closed admission; Link guest keeps isolation and revocation. The accepted tradeoff is unknown historical attribution, not a known failing behavior. A concrete counterexample or missing invariant reopens its existing owner.

The [full ledger](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/blob/f59d23ceae976ee0abdd25eb13f370e18d7d6495/docs/implementation/SPN-157-contract-audit.md) freezes the original specification at `754e6531` and investigation at `9ca506c5`. All **19** original obligations map to **A1–A9**: actual durable SIGKILL/restart and original rows; interrupted real IPC/SQLite nonadmission; physical orphan closure; authenticated archives and exact retained bytes; both ownership/readiness orderings; durable commit/private release; expired/revoked authority refusal; failed-stop/custody recovery; truthful first-failure controls. Negatives reject actual state/data/ownership/authority violations, not only diagnostic wording. Existing native process, persistence, cleanup and deadline assertions remain intact.

### 🧪 Source-bound evidence and historical limits

- Original run **43544143900 attempt 1**, supervisor **132291548937**, remains **129 passed/2 failed**: durable running **8,814 ms**, readiness-first **23,720 ms**. Source `2204b8c4`, base `ebf0842f`, tested `62bc0229`, tree `d6bb8192`. The generic crash error does not establish the reached stage; the child timeout has no reliable selected-child attribution. Successful comparator **43540593013/132280423639** remains a separate observation. Both complete original logs were decoded and matched in [immutable failure archive 5e1b7a9f](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/tree/5e1b7a9fac17c69ff9174caa9da9f8d13713737d/docs/review-assets/spn-098-failure-43544143900).
- Actual feedback-source Linux acceptance: **43572824567 attempt 1**, source `5e72d33ac9cb3a86b3496345209493d6c86e469c`, base `754e65317744e5ce97ede501935c6586e4875f2a`, tested `c603a21de6446d623145589eca811ab6dfb38152`, source/tested tree `f9cf0bc6e26551713a0d66f5b273d944c44a10fc`. Supervisor **132380865473: 131/131**, recovery **132380865510: 619/619**; running **696 ms**, readiness-first **7,092 ms**. [Published archive d34f2ff3](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/tree/d34f2ff3cf2b33217e6d8959d97ba2af483fd692/docs/review-assets/spn-098-validation-5e72d33a) retains original logs, source/plan/aggregate bindings and historical records. These are their original executions, not f59d CI or proof of historical repair.
- [Supplemental evidence](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/tree/f59d23ceae976ee0abdd25eb13f370e18d7d6495/docs/review-assets/spn-157-contract-audit) preserves full remaining-job **132380865589** log/metadata/hashes, explicitly passing the selected missing/failed/cancelled/skipped-work aggregate controls. Its two optional SPN-146 benchmark skips are unrelated. Source receipts independently bind all **28** cited source/workflow entries and entire maintenance/backup folders across frozen754, audit50dc, actual87 and f59d; accepted SPN-159 integration does not change these owners. No SPN-098 runtime is imported here.

### 🔎 Independent reviews and local verification

Both nonimplementing reviewers assessed the complete original L outcome, actual assertions/negatives, evidence and explicit revised method on **exact f59d23ce**, with no actionable findings:

- **A, `/root/review_a`: 100/100**, report `spn157-review-a-f59d23ce.md`, SHA-256 `a57b94c9fec27679941ba017efc6072c0d375c21793331374c6dfe6a514366b3`.
- **B, `/root/review_b`: 100/100**, report `spn157-review-b-f59d23ce.md`, SHA-256 `e33f2b9cf1bddc39d70eb3da4a541b05e99b9840fb1f17ce6ec605c519723687`.

Each scored the complete rubric at **35/35 scope, 25/25 correctness/data/access, 20/20 regression, 10/10 workflow/operations, 10/10 maintainability/complexity**.

Their own 50dc portable executions retain those original labels: A **10/10**, B **10/10** protocol controls plus **5/5** aggregate CLI controls; unchanged source identities carry applicability. Both freshly passed backlog and exact-base PR checks on f59d. Implementer index/backlog/focused-format/exact-PR checks passed under pinned Node 26.13.0, shared serialization and the unchanged 2 GiB/eight-minute watchdog. No guard abort; owned processes and lock cleared. Receipts are `spn157-integrated87-{index,format,backlog,pr}.json`, A `spn157-review-a-{backlog,pr}-f59d23ce.{json,log}`, B `spn157-review-b-f59d-{backlog,pr}.{json,log}` and `spn157-review-b-f59d-cleanup.json`; original reports/iterations and root verification are reserved for the immutable validation archive below. No unaffected local matrix was repeated.

### 🚦Landing, current-head gates and retained work

Conditional bookkeeping deletes only SPN-157, removes its SPN-098 dependency while preserving failure/audit provenance and that consumer's own gates, appends 157 **after 159** (count seven), and regenerates the **27-ticket** index. No ID allocation or grooming reset. Full grooming follows actual landing.

**Applicable f59d current-head CI is pending; no validation has been published yet.** The evidence JSON/gzip paths conservatively select full hosted coverage under the unchanged classifier despite this documentation-only implementation. Preserve that routing. All seven required gates and selected work must pass; existing consumer results do not substitute for new-head CI.

Reserved immutable publication destinations (not yet created/published):

- [Validation record](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/blob/archive/spn-157-validation-f59d23ce-20261114/docs/review-assets/spn-157-validation-f59d23ce/README.md): `archive/spn-157-validation-f59d23ce-20261114`, path `docs/review-assets/spn-157-validation-f59d23ce/`: exact review iterations/receipts, root verification, native source bindings and first-attempt current-head plan/jobs/results/failures.
- [Completion record](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/blob/archive/spn-157-completion-f59d23ce-20261114/docs/review-assets/spn-157-completion-f59d23ce/README.md): `archive/spn-157-completion-f59d23ce-20261114`, path `docs/review-assets/spn-157-completion-f59d23ce/`: accepted source/merge/check/archive identities and actual guarded cleanup results.
- Unique old implementation: `archive/spn-157-local-44f9a536-20261114`, exact target `44f9a5365fe290236b882606933e63b8ef317363`, retaining its `93257f23` parent and all unique code/history before any obsolete-branch deletion.

Only a verified, published terminal record supersedes the corresponding pending checkpoint above; an absent reservation is not evidence.

Fresh prepublication inventory found only `codex/spn-157-current-investigation` at f59d and `codex/spn-157-supervisor-handoffs` at44; no live remote ticket refs or active/all-state PR ownership, and one active157 worktree. Nothing was deleted. Recheck every head and active PR immediately before post-merge cleanup, durably preserve unique old44 work, then remove only obsolete ticket refs/worktrees. Record any blocked deletion rather than claiming completion.
